name: OGBN-MAG: Microsoft Academic Graph Heterogeneous Node Classification Benchmark
description: OGBN-MAG is a large-scale heterogeneous network benchmark extracted from the Microsoft Academic Graph (MAG), comprising 1,939,743 nodes across 4 entity types (736,389 papers, 1,134,649 authors, 8,740 institutions, and 59,965 fields of study) and 21,111,007 directed relation edges (paper cites paper, author writes paper, author affiliated with institution, and paper has topic field of study). Each paper node is equipped with a 128-dimensional Word2Vec feature vector extracted from paper titles and abstracts. The task is to predict the publication venue (349 venue classes) of papers published in 2019 given the heterogeneous relational context, evaluated under a realistic temporal split (papers before 2018 for train, 2018 for validation, 2019 for test).
